provenance_and_exclusion.prior_construction_sources: Ripoll-Sanchez 2023 (92 NPP-GPCR CeNGEN expression + in vitro deorphanization + anatomical diffusion range), Cook 2019 EM chemical/gap connectome, Witvliet 2021 EM conserved core, CeNGEN monoamine/polarity. Zero pairs derived from Randi 2023 WT or unc-31.
provenance_and_exclusion.exclusion_rule: Primary analysis is already strictly non-circular because Ripoll-Sanchez 2023 NPP-GPCR priors were constructed independently of Randi 2023. As an additional ultra-conservative anti-circularity audit (guarding against the Randi >=53 unc-31-selected wireless-edge trap), we also report the strict complement excluding all 192 co-tested wired-absent pairs with wt_q<0.05, unc31_q>=0.05, and |R_unc31|<0.5|R_WT|.
